snippet.title: Universal Pictures and DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon: Riders of the Skies on Nex Playground!
snippet.description:
Train, fly, and defend in the epic world of Universal Pictures and DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon: Riders of the Skies on Nex Playground!

🐲 Choose your favorite dragon
✨ Master the art of flying in six immersive maps
🎮 Perfect for ages 8+ and up to 2 players

Get ready to become a Dragon Rider today!

Directed by Charles Barratt

Universal Pictures and DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon: Riders of the Skies is available today on Nex Playground with Play Pass. 

More details: https://www.nexplayground.com/games/how-to-train-your-dragon-riders-of-the-skies

#HowToTrainYourDragon #HTTYD #NexPlayground #RidersOfTheSkies
